caption: The card in the first row, second column, originally had a card with a horse pattern, but now it has changed to a card with a white circle, a brush, and colorful footprints. The card in the third row, second column, which previously featured a tooth pattern, has been replaced by a card with a black and white striped brush on a white background.
The shooting perspective has zoomed out. The black bird that was on the left tree stump is now in front of the right tree stump, positioned on the grass with its head facing downward.

The hanger on the left side of the white T-shirt with "AESTHETE" printed in yellow letters has disappeared, and the white T-shirt has moved to the right. The black pants on the far right have disappeared. A new orange shirt with a pattern has appeared on the left side of the scene. The black and white checkered top and the yellow shirt on the right have swapped positions.

The posture of the person changes from a position where the right leg is raised, the left leg stands firmly on the ground, the body slightly tilts to the right, and both hands are extended forward with fingers spread, to a pose where the head faces away from the camera, the left leg stands straight, the right leg is raised and bent, and both arms are extended horizontally.

The three people in the image change their posture from three individuals facing right with their left leg extended forward and right arm raised, to three individuals standing side by side with their arms extended horizontally. The man on the left changes from facing right to facing forward. The woman in the middle changes from facing right to facing forward. The man on the right changes from facing right to facing forward.

The posture of the person in the image changes from a position where the left leg is raised, the right leg stands firmly on the ground, the body is slightly tilted to the right, and both arms are bent with the right hand pointing forward, to a posture where the body leans forward, the left leg stands firmly, the right leg is raised, both hands are extended forward with fingers slightly bent, and the head is slightly tilted upward.
The white remote control that was in the center of the scene has been moved to the box on the right side. A white cup has appeared in the middle of the scene.

The ambient lighting has brightened. The squirrel on the left side of the scene has moved to the left, with its head lowered and facing the tree stump. A new peanut has appeared on the ground in front of the tree stump on the left.
The black basket on the front of the yellow bike in the foreground has become smaller.

The polar bear in the middle of the frame, which was previously lying down with its head resting on the mother bear's back, is now leaning against the mother bear with its head facing downward.

The scene has become brighter. Three people stand in a row, with the person in the middle raising both arms and the person on the bottom sitting cross-legged while extending their arms. They all face forward, with their heads turned to the left. The three people now lean back, bending their bodies backward, with their right hands pointing toward the sky and their left hands crossed over their chests.
The mouse has moved from the right side of the wooden box's door, peeking its head out of the hole, to standing on its hind legs in front of the wooden box entrance.

The lighting in the environment has become brighter. The card in the second row, first column features a white sock on a black background, replaced by a white backpack on a black background. The card in the third row, second column features a card with a smiling white tooth on a black background, replaced by a card with a pair of black footprints on a white background. The number 84 on the side of the red and white bus has disappeared. The yellow ball in front of the yellow excavator on the ottoman has been replaced by a blue circular toy with the number 59.

The person in the light blue jacket, who was previously standing behind the orange-jacketed person with their back to the camera, is now standing to the left of the orange-jacketed person, facing forward. The person in the orange jacket, who was previously supporting the person in the blue jacket, is now standing in the middle, facing forward.
The lighting in the scene has increased.
The blue mist inhaler on the left side of the scene has been replaced with a purple water droplet toy.

The posture of the figure changes from having the head tilted back, eyes looking upward, both hands extended high, and the body leaning backward to a side profile with the right leg lifted forward, the left leg supporting the body, and both arms extended.

The scene has darkened, and yellow lights have come on around the area. The white pickup truck in the rear right of the frame has disappeared. The blue car that was previously in the center of the frame is no longer visible.

The ambient lighting has slightly brightened. The pink bowl on the right side of the second level has moved to the top of the first level. A rectangular white object has appeared in the original position of the pink bowl on the second level. The rectangular toiletry bottle on the left side of the second level has disappeared, and a rectangular bar of soap has appeared in its place.
The ambient lighting has become brighter. The black mouse on the right side of the desk has disappeared, and a black camera with a lens attached has appeared in its place.
